correctness.rationale: The code domain is exactly the compatibility graph on all 216 self-non-overlapping ternary words of lengths two through five. Exhaustive branch-and-bound with a valid coloring upper bound proves clique number 17; forcing each of all 72 short vertices proves maximum 16 in the short-word subdomain. Explicit witnesses are independently rechecked against the definitions. Risk: a software bug could invalidate a computer-assisted proof, mitigated by the small explicit model, direct witness checks, and fully embedded verifier.

value.rationale: The claim resolves a natural exact small-parameter instance of the published minimum-average-length problem and gives a sharp structural boundary: the presence of even one shorter word lowers the maximum cardinality from 17 to 16.
